{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter out refunded orders (they don't contribute to revenue)
revenue_orders = real_orders[real_orders['status'] == 'completed']

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = revenue_orders.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Find the channel with the highest revenue
best_channel = channel_revenue.idxmax()
best_revenue = channel_revenue.max()

# Output results
print("Channel revenue (after filtering QA and refunded orders):")
print(channel_revenue)
print(f"\nChannel with most revenue: {best_channel} ($ {best_revenue:,.2f})")"}
